Actual harvester/storage reservoir at C5.1. U1.VBAT is modeled as power_in, consistent with KiCad power-pin semantics and its official BQ25570 symbol; this is not a signal-bidirectional terminal.

erc_marker_exclusions: LTR-390UV INT is an unused open-drain output tied to GND, with no pull-up or driven-high source on the output. Electrical inference: its sink cannot contend with GND; LiteOn identifies open-drain operation but an explicit recommendation to ground was not located. Interrupt functionality is unavailable; keep LS_INT_EN disabled. Only this exact GND PWR_FLAG marker is excluded.

TMP117 ALERT is intentionally unavailable and grounded. TI TMP117 datasheet section 8.2.1 explicitly permits grounding ALERT when unused. Open-drain pin type retained; this exact marker is contention with the external GND PWR_FLAG, not a driven-high circuit.

LIS2DH12 SDO/SA0 is grounded to select I2C address 0x18 with CS high, as specified in ST datasheet section 6.1.1. Bidirectional type retained for its SPI role. Only this exact GND PWR_FLAG marker is excluded. Firmware follow-up: disable internal SDO pull-up using CTRL_REG0 SDO_PU_DISC while preserving required other bits.
